'''Strilth''' was a [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked for [[Rogun Matt'rik|Rogun the Butcher]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was sent to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] to receive the captive [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Combo]] from [[Raskurro]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. However, a [[Voidhound|smuggler]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] arrived to [[Rescue of Combo|rescue]] him and [[Death/Legends|killed]] Strilth.

==Biography==
The [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] Strilth was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Rogun Matt'rik|Rogun the Butcher]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" /> Around [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> [[Gender/Legends|he]], along with his [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]], were dispatched to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] to secure the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Combo]], who was being held by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] in a safehouse. The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] hoped to collect the bounty Rogun had put on Combo, a member of a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] crew that had had been raiding Rogun's ships.<ref name="TOR" />

While Strilth was discussing the price Rogun would pay for the slicer with [[Raskurro]] the Hutt, a [[Voidhound|notorious smuggler]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] also wanted by Rogun and [[Vaz Traniff]], the leader of the pirate crew, arrived to [[Rescue of Combo|rescue]] Combo. Raskurro was intrigued by their presence, angering Strilth. The Houk threatened the Hutt with [[Death/Legends|death]] for dealing with an enemy of Rogun's. Raskurro replied that Strilth did not have the authority to start a war with the Hutts on Rogun's behalf, and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] used the threat to persuade the Hutt that they were a safer business partner. Raskurro agreed to work with them and left the two groups to settle the disagreement on their own. Strilth and his bodyguards attempted to kill the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]], but were defeated.<ref name="TOR" />
